subject: Post-call: MAP draft — priority lanes, owners, and signature deadline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@horizonai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft — priority lanes, owners, and signature deadline

Hi Claire / Samir — thanks again for a productive demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the MAP and target close dates: 

Summary of today's decisions:
- Scope: initial pilot = inference for our summarization endpoint (10k qps peak, 1–2s latency target).
- KPIs: P95 latency <= 1.8s; token cost target < $0.0008/token for production.
- Risks: data residency needs EU-only for some clients (flagged, not blocking).

Draft MAP attached (MAP_v0.3.xlsx) — high-level milestones I propose: 
1) Pilot configuration & infra runbook (owner: Horizon Eng) — target: 2026-11-22
2) Performance validation (owner: Redwood SRE) — target: 2026-11-29
3) Contract & procurement sign-off (owner: Horizon Procurement) — target signature deadline: 2026-12-13
4) Onboarding & rollout (owner: Horizon PM) — target: 2026-12-20

Open ask for Horizon: please confirm the procurement/contract signature deadline. We recommended 2026-12-13 to allow a two-week buffer before onboarding, but if your procurement window is tighter we can discuss fast-track steps (legal redline freeze, limited-scope SOW).

Action items I plan to track in the MAP: milestone owner (Horizon vs Redwood), dependencies (legal, security questionnaire, PO), and acceptance criteria. I attached a draft SOW too (SOW_draft_v1.2.pdf) — legal may want to start redlines in parallel.

Next step — can we aim to confirm owners and a hard signature deadline by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-10)? If Horizon needs a different cadence, propose date options and I'll update the MAP.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v1.2.pdf (pdf)

From: Claire Ng <claire@horizonai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@horizonai.com>, Horizon AI Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft — priority lanes, owners, and signature deadline

Thanks Olga — great recap and thanks for the clear MAP draft. A few notes from our side after syncing with procurement & legal this morning:

- Procurement suggests a signature deadline of 2026-12-20 instead of 12-13 due to our quarterly vendor review board (they have a final meeting the prior week).
- Legal asked to see a short redline-friendly SOW; we'll prioritize a limited-scope SOW for signature to accelerate hardware allocation.
- Engineering can own Pilot config and performance validation but will need Redwood SRE on-call for the load test week (we flagged 2026-11-29 as ok).

We can meet halfway if Redwood can commit to a legal-ready SOW by 2026-11-17 and a DocuSign-friendly contract package by 2026-12-06 — that would let Procurement present at the vendor board on 2026-12-13 and complete signature by 12-20. 

I'll loop procurement explicitly on this thread (cc'd).

—Claire
Claire Ng
Head of Platform, Horizon AI
claire@horizonai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon AI Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>, Claire Ng <claire@horizonai.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft — priority lanes, owners, and signature deadline

Thanks for the thread. Quick internal notes: 
- I'll own the performance validation milestone on Redwood's side and coordinate SRE availability for the week of 2026-11-29.
- Marissa, can you confirm we can get a redline-ready SOW (limited scope) to Claire by 2026-11-17? If legal needs an earlier handoff, let's flag now.
- If Horizon's procurement must present on 12-13, we should prepare the contract package by 2026-12-06 as Claire suggested. I'll flag an expedited review with our Contracts lead.

Also, I've added a short dependency column in the MAP: 
- Legal redline (input: SOW_v1.2) — owner: Redwood Legal (Marissa)
- Data residency assessment (if EU-only required) — owner: Horizon Security
- Procurement PO issuance — owner: Horizon Procurement

I'll update MAP_v0.3 with the dependency column and owners now and re-upload as v0.4; Olga, can you share the DocuSign envelope once we have a signature-ready copy?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@horizonai.com>, Horizon AI Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft — priority lanes, owners, and signature deadline

All — thanks for the quick turn. I updated the MAP (attached as MAP_v0.4.xlsx) with the dependency column and confirmed owners per thread: 
- Pilot config: Horizon Eng (Claire) — 2026-11-22
- Performance validation: Redwood SRE (Karthik) — load test week 2026-11-29
- Legal redline freeze / contract package: Redwood Legal (Marissa) / Horizon Legal — target package by 2026-12-06
- Procurement signature: Horizon Procurement — target signature window 2026-12-13 to 2026-12-20 (preferred final signature 2026-12-20)

Can we close on the following items by EOD 2026-11-12 so I can lock MAP_v0.4 and share the DocuSign envelope?
1) Horizon to confirm the preferred hard signature date (one date between 12/13 and 12/20).
2) Marissa to confirm SOW ready-by date (goal: 2026-11-17).
3) Karthik to confirm SRE on-call window for 11/29 load tests.

I'll create the DocuSign envelope and share the link once legal confirms the redline freeze. If Horizon wants a canary scope agreement to speed hardware allocation, we can include a 60-day limited-scope addendum in the initial SOW.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v0.4.xlsx (spreadsheet)
